nodes.label: Chat turn
nodes.summary: A message typed in a chat runs one headless `claude -p` process and streams its events back to the browser live.

nodes.label: Send message
nodes.summary: The chat composer posts the typed text to the server.

nodes.label: Messages endpoint
nodes.summary: POST /api/chats/:id/messages validates the body, titles a new chat from the text and starts the turn.

nodes.label: Spawn claude CLI
nodes.summary: startTurn records a run, picks the mode's model, and spawns `claude -p` with resume/session id, stream-json output and the Flightdeck hook settings, with API keys stripped from the env.

nodes.label: Parse stream events
nodes.summary: Each stdout JSON line is validated as a ClaudeEvent; a non-subscription init aborts the run, results end the turn.

nodes.label: Append to feed
nodes.summary: Feed items are appended to the chat's JSONL file and pushed to live subscribers.

nodes.label: SSE feed stream
nodes.summary: GET /api/chats/:id/feed replays the whole JSONL then streams new items with keep-alive pings.

nodes.label: Derive and render
nodes.summary: ChatView's EventSource collects items and a pure derive() folds them into text, tool activity, cards and notes.

nodes.label: Finish run
nodes.summary: On process close the run is marked finished/failed/stopped with git HEAD after, the edit lock is released and open cards are cancelled.

nodes.label: Tool approval hook
nodes.summary: Before every tool call Claude Code asks Flightdeck over an HTTP PreToolUse hook, which allows, denies, or holds it on an approval card.

nodes.label: POST /hook
nodes.summary: The hook endpoint parses the PreToolUse payload and answers with hookSpecificOutput.

nodes.label: Find active run
nodes.summary: The session id is mapped to the chat's active run; unknown sessions are denied.

nodes.label: Mode and edit lock
nodes.summary: Edits are refused in Discuss mode and when another chat in the project holds the edit lock.

nodes.label: Evaluate project rules
nodes.summary: The project's allow/ask/deny rules are matched (Deny > Ask > Allow), splitting Bash commands and guarding hidden exec and redirects.

nodes.label: Show approval card
nodes.summary: An Ask verdict records a pending approval, appends a card to the feed and holds the hook until clicked or timed out.

nodes.label: User decides
nodes.summary: The card in the chat posts allow (optionally always-allow with a pattern) or deny with a reason.

nodes.label: Resolve approval
nodes.summary: POST /api/approvals/:id settles the pending card, saves an always-allow rule if asked, and releases the waiting hook.

nodes.label: Map generation
nodes.summary: A read-only Claude agent explores the repo and returns a diagram as structured output, which is validated and saved in .flightdeck/.

nodes.label: Generate request
nodes.summary: The map screen posts to /api/projects/:id/maps/:view/generate.

nodes.label: Spawn mapper agent
nodes.summary: startGeneration spawns `claude -p` with the common and view prompt, a draft-07 JSON schema, disallowed edit/web tools and its own map hook.

nodes.label: Read-only map hook
nodes.summary: POST /hook/map allows only reading, searching and git inspection tools for the running job, denying everything else without cards.

nodes.label: Track progress
nodes.summary: Tool-use events update the job's step count and activity text, polled by the UI.

nodes.label: Validate map
nodes.summary: validateMap rejects structural problems and drops nonexistent file references and bad edges with warnings.

nodes.label: Write map file
nodes.summary: The map with its commit, model and warnings is written to .flightdeck/<view>.json in the repo.

nodes.label: Map viewing
nodes.summary: The map screen loads a stored map, marks nodes changed since its commit, lays it out and lets the reader drill in and open files.

nodes.label: Fetch map
nodes.summary: MapView polls GET /api/projects/:id/maps/:view, faster while a generation runs.

nodes.label: Read stored map
nodes.summary: readMap loads and schema-checks .flightdeck/<view>.json.

nodes.label: Detect changes
nodes.summary: changedSince diffs against the map's commit plus untracked files, and staleNodeIds marks covering nodes and their ancestors.

nodes.label: Lift edges, layout
nodes.summary: Edges are lifted to the visible level and ELK lays out the cards rendered by React Flow.

nodes.label: Open node files
nodes.summary: The file viewer fetches GET /api/projects/:id/file, which serves files or directory listings confined to the project and outside .git.

nodes.label: Stop a turn
nodes.summary: The stop button ends a running chat turn cleanly with SIGINT so it is recorded as stopped.

nodes.label: Stop request
nodes.summary: The chat posts to /api/chats/:id/stop.

nodes.label: Cancel and signal
nodes.summary: stopTurn flags the run, cancels its open approval cards and sends SIGINT to the claude process.

nodes.label: Add a project
nodes.summary: Registers an existing git repository on the box as a project with default models and starter approval rules.

nodes.label: Add project form
nodes.summary: The sidebar form posts a path and optional name to /api/projects.

nodes.label: Validate repository
nodes.summary: The server checks the path is absolute, an existing directory, a git repo, and not already a project.

nodes.label: Insert with rules
nodes.summary: The project row is inserted with the default model and seeded with TEMPLATE_RULES.

nodes.label: Edit rules, models
nodes.summary: Project settings let the user add/delete rules and set Discuss/Build models via the rules and settings endpoints.
